description: This file defines the API for interacting with associated MoCA devices on a specific interface, including a class 'MoCAInterfaceAssociatedDevice' with methods to retrieve various device parameters such as MAC address, Node ID, version, rates, power levels, and status indicators.

classes.name: MoCAInterfaceAssociatedDevice
classes.description: Class representing an associated MoCA device with methods to retrieve its parameters and status.

methods.name: get_MACAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of the associated device.

methods.name: get_NodeID
methods.description: Retrieves the Node ID of the remote device.

methods.name: get_PreferredNC
methods.description: Checks if the remote device is a preferred Network Coordinator.

methods.name: get_HighestVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the highest supported MoCA version of the device.

methods.name: get_PHYTxRate
methods.description: Retrieves the PHY transmit rate in Mbps.

methods.name: get_PHYRxRate
methods.description: Retrieves the PHY receive rate in Mbps.

methods.name: get_TxPowerControlReduction
methods.description: Retrieves the reduction in transmitter power due to power control.

methods.name: get_RxPowerLevel
methods.description: Retrieves the received power level in dBm.

methods.name: get_TxBcastRate
methods.description: Retrieves the broadcast PHY transmit rate in Mbps.

methods.name: get_RxBcastPowerLevel
methods.description: Retrieves the broadcast power level in dBm.

methods.name: get_TxPackets
methods.description: Retrieves the number of transmitted packets.

methods.name: get_RxPackets
methods.description: Retrieves the number of received packets.

methods.name: get_RxErroredAndMissedPackets
methods.description: Retrieves the count of errored and missed packets.

methods.name: get_QAM256Capable
methods.description: Checks if the device supports QAM256.

methods.name: get_RxSNR
methods.description: Retrieves the signal-to-noise ratio in dBm.

methods.name: get_Active
methods.description: Checks if the device is currently active in the network.
